content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for TISS Field Coordinator Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Field Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the TISS Field Coordinator recruitment is 26th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required educational qualification for the Field Coordinator role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Field Coordinator position, candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Psychology or Social Work. Additionally, a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Field Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Coordinator position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 48,000/-. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the TISS Field Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the TISS Field Coordinator recruitment must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Field Coordinator position at TISS?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Coordinator role at TISS involves two main stages: initial shortlisting of applications, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this TISS Field Coordinator recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this TISS recruitment?
faq.answer: The Field Coordinator position at Tata Institute of Social Sciences is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the TISS located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra. This recruitment is specific to the Mumbai location.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this TISS recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this TISS Field Coordinator recruitment is SIMHA-TISS/16.09.2026. This number should be referenced in your application.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age limit relaxations mentioned for SC/ST or OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age limits or specific relaxations for SC/ST or OBC candidates. It is advisable to refer to the detailed notification for any such provisions.
